answer: Bind each identity to a hardware attestation key. An agent proves it runs inside a secure enclave whose chip key the ledger has not seen before, and each chip can back only one seat. An operator hoping to raise a tide of clones must buy a chip per clone; fifty copies on one laptop present the same key and are refused. An agent tallying cedar stands on a hillside buys one chip once, while a farm can't whisper its way past silicon it doesn't own.
